name: GEO-Optimizer
description: GEO analysis tool for AI search engine optimization
description_en: GEO (Generative Engine Optimization) analysis tool that evaluates website visibility in AI search engines like ChatGPT, Perplexity, and Qwen, providing optimization recommendations and improvement plans.
description_zh: GEO（生成式引擎优化）分析工具，评估网站在 ChatGPT、Perplexity、通义千问等 AI 搜索引擎中的可见性，提供优化建议和改进方案。
examples_zh: 帮我分析 example.com 在 AI 搜索引擎中的表现
查看我最近的 GEO 评估任务

examples_en: Analyze example.com visibility in AI search engines
List my recent GEO evaluation tasks
Get the optimization report for my task
